item.title: Did a 19th-century freemason really predict World War 3 between Islam and Zionism?
item.description: The “Pike letter,” allegedly written in 1871, is said to predict three world wars: the first to topple empires and establish communism, the second to defeat fascism and pave the way for Israel, and a third future conflict between Western and Islamic powers, leading to global upheaval and a radical transformation of religion. Its existence remains unverified, yet it continues to circulate and intrigue.

Are Kyedae Shymko and Sakura Shymko related? Breaking down their splits with TenZ and JasonTheWeen
item.description: Sakura Shymko and Kyedae Shymko are sisters who both confirmed breakups in the same week. Kyedae ended her six year relationship with Tyson Ngo known as TenZ. JasonTheWeen later announced his split from Sakura. Online rumors followed but both sides denied cheating. TenZ and John Choi also spoke out against false claims.

item.title: What really happened when MrBeast offered 1 million dollars to contestants in Beast Games Season 2
item.description: Beast Games Season 2 Episode 8 forced ten contestants to choose between sharing $1 million or taking it for themselves. Nick withdrew $250,000, and Monika secretly accepted $500,000 from MrBeast to give up a powerful coin. The episode ended in a cliffhanger. Two episodes remain before the $5 million finale airs on February 25.

item.title: US-Israel meeting: Trump urges Netanyahu to continue negotiations with Iran, warns Tehran by reminding 'Midnight Hammer'
item.description: US President Donald Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, emphasizing the need for continued negotiations with Iran on a nuclear deal. Trump warned Tehran of severe consequences if talks falter, referencing past US military actions. The leaders also addressed the Gaza conflict and broader Middle East instability, with international calls for restraint amid regional tensions.

item.title: Tumbler Ridge student describes chaos during Canada school shooting: 'We were formulating an escape plan'
item.description: A devastating mass shooting at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School in British Columbia has claimed nine lives and injured 25. A Grade 12 student recounted the terrifying hours spent barricaded in a classroom as alarms blared. Police found the suspect deceased at the scene. This incident marks one of Canada's worst shootings, leaving a community in shock and grief.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: JD Vance defends Trump’s racist Obama video, says it’s ‘not a real controversy’
item.description: In a recent public address, US Vice President JD Vance dismissed the uproar over a controversial AI-generated video depicting the Obamas as apes, which was circulated by former President Donald Trump. Vance emphasized that this matter has moved past the point of effective discussion and highlighted the importance of focusing on pressing issues facing the nation.

‘Not going to get in the gutter with this woman’: Pam Bondi refuses to apologize after Indian-origin Democrat Jayapal asks her to at Epstein files hearing
item.description: Representative Pramila Jayapal and Attorney General Bondi clashed over the Jeffrey Epstein scandal. Jayapal accused the DOJ of redacting powerful predators' names while releasing survivors' identities, demanding an apology to victims present. Bondi refused, calling Jayapal's actions "theatrics" and a "gutter" tactic, while Jayapal alleged a "massive coverup."

item.title: Two boys, aged 13 and 12, in hospital after being stabbed in class at London school
item.description: Counter-terrorism police are investigating an "American-style" stabbing at Kingsbury High School where two boys, aged 12 and 13, were injured. A 13-year-old former pupil was arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after allegedly climbing over a wall and entering a science lesson. Both injured boys are in serious but stable condition.

item.title: ‘European pride’: Kallas responds to boos for JD Vance during Winter Olympics opening ceremony in Italy
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance was booed at the Winter Olympics opening ceremony in Milan, with EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas attributing the reaction to "European pride" amid growing transatlantic tensions. Kallas cited recent US criticism of the EU, including Vance's questioning of shared democratic visions and comments on disinformation.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie kidnapping case: Third ransom letter sent to TMZ demands 1 Bitcoin to reveal ‘name of individual involved’
item.description: A new letter reportedly sent to TMZ demands one bitcoin, valued at $66,000, for the identity of Savannah Guthrie's mother's kidnapper. This is the third alleged note since Nancy Guthrie's disappearance on January 31. The letter includes a working bitcoin address and emphasizes the urgency of the situation.
